title: abstraction-solutions.com goes live
items: The Abstraction Solutions website launched on its own domain.

title: Service pages
items: Pages for AI Education, AI Automation, Custom Workflows and Models, Tools & Code.

title: Legal pages, case studies, ROI calculator and new videos
items: Privacy Policy, Terms of Service and Returns & Refunds pages.
Case studies of real projects, including the CBHS information chatbot.
An ROI calculator, plus a link to it right after every instant quote.
11 new AI education videos on the AI Education page.
Find us on YouTube and Instagram (@abstraction.solutions).

title: Automation recipes, Built in Memphis and honest status labels
items: Automation recipes: one concrete automation for each of six trades, with a Quote this button that fills in the quote tool.
A Built in Memphis page for local businesses.
Live labels, so it's clear what works today.
The homepage ROI estimate now states its assumption plainly: about 60% of the task gets automated.
AI Education and Models links on the homepage and in every page's footer.
This changelog.

title: Check your order and pay online
items: Check an order with your email and confirmation number, see its status and quote, and pay securely online with Stripe.

title: 50% off for clubs and nonprofits
items: A Clubs & Nonprofits page for Rotary clubs, civic clubs and nonprofits: websites, member updates, event signups, newsletters, dues and donation pages, and simple AI.
Clubs and nonprofits get 50% off every project. Mention it when you order and your final quote takes half off.

title: A better site assistant
items: Ask "What do you do?" and get our services, with suggested questions to tap.
On phones, the assistant opens as a full screen instead of a small window.

title: For Memphis small businesses and nonprofits
items: Our offer now focuses on Memphis small businesses and nonprofits.
Through Friday, November 13, 2026, quotes are 25% off for everyone other than nonprofits. Nonprofits keep 50% off. The discounts don't stack.

title: Fewer pages, easier to find
items: Nonprofit work and Built in Memphis now live on the Custom Workflows page, so there are fewer pages to click through.
Join our mailing list on the homepage for offers, early access, newsletters and giveaways.
Find us on TikTok, linked in the footer.

title: Track your progress on AI Education videos
items: Every Education video now shows how much of it you've watched, and a green check once you've watched it all.
Sign in to save your progress to your account. Only time you actually watch counts, so skipping to the end doesn't.
Finish a video for the first time and you get a small celebration.
Every account now has a permanent 8-digit user ID, shown on the order page when you're signed in.

title: The AI Education Playground
items: A new Playground page under AI Education, with two demos that run right in your browser.
Gradient descent: type any equation (x^2 + 3x, sin(3x) + 0.2x^2 ...), see it and its slope written out, and watch a ball roll down to the lowest point, step by step.
Genetic algorithm: type a phrase and watch 250 random guesses evolve into it, generation by generation.

title: Coins for AI Education videos
items: Signed in, finishing an AI Education video earns coins: 5, 10 or 15 depending on its length, once per video.
Coins burst out of the green check when you finish a video and fly into your balance next to Account.
Spend coins on 5% to 20% off one project from the new Rewards panel.

title: Glitching quotes, an all-caps title, and the AI Playground up front
items: The home page quotes glitch now and then, the way the title does, and glitch into the next quote.
The site title now reads ABSTRACTION SOLUTIONS.
The AI Playground has its own card on the home page and the AI Education page, with a small live demo.

title: Quotes that rewrite themselves, and words that glitch across the site
items: The home page quotes are now edited into one another: a green cursor backspaces one quote and types the next, which decodes from code as it lands.
Every few seconds a random word somewhere on the page glitches the way the title does, then settles back.
